faq.a: No. StaminaBoost provides educational lifestyle content only. Always consult a healthcare provider for medical concerns.
A rule-based engine maps your age, BMI, activity, goals, and lifestyle answers to exercises, foods, and copy variants. Optional AI may enhance your intro paragraph when enabled.
We never promise fixed day counts. Many people notice energy and habit gains in 4–8 weeks with consistency; individual results vary.

faq.q: What do I get after purchase?
faq.a: A full PDF download plus an email with your link. Preview is watermarked; the paid report is complete.
If your PDF fails to generate, we will redeliver. Contact support with your order reference.
